name: Ruststain
description: Inhabits augment maintenance systems and accelerates cosmetic degradation — chrome dulls faster, synthetic skin develops premature wear patterns, joints develop squeaks.
observed_behavior: Adjusts maintenance cycle timing to allow cosmetic degradation while keeping functional components operational. The augment works fine. It just looks terrible.
story_hooks: An aug shop discovers Ruststain is actually protecting the augment by sacrificing appearance to redirect maintenance resources to critical systems
